hypothesis: Repeated complete message.list() pagination after each websocket transcript change dominates message-read calls and bytes in long sessions. Single newest-desc page with overlap against short-lived cache can reduce storage-side reads while requiring authoritative full reads at run completion, compaction, resync and reconnect.
prediction: For 1005 messages and 10 ordinary tool_end events, reduce message.list calls and read payload bytes by >=60%; keep identical full-history snapshots. No claim about model tokens or real Cloudflare latency.
falsification: <60% call saving, any mismatch or stale history in tested scenarios, runtime regression >30%, or >2 MiB new retained memory in fixture.

cases.action: tool changes, compaction/transcript_reset, reconnection, multi socket

invariants: Snapshot contents exactly equal server transcript each delivered event, incl edits to last item
Force authoritative history on reconnect/explicit resync, on run_end and compaction
No persistent secondary history; per DO instance state only
No changes to model context or cache
No live Cloudflare deploy or user data

metrics.provenance: perf clock around actual Socket handler with deterministic fake Harness

thresholds.correctness: exact history JSON equality at every snapshot, always
thresholds.maintainability: localized app helper using existing SDK; no durable cache

artifactPlan.runLog: GitHub Actions test output verbatim; later separately persisted as transcribed runs.jsonl with source commit/run/job

limits: Deterministic fake harness integration measures app WebSocket events and exact message.list paging but not sqlite/DO costs
